cover.sub: 海关问答 · 背完直接过

blocks.text: DAY 01 · 落地第一关
blocks.say_zh: 第一天，落地美国的第一关。

blocks.text: 机场入境与通关
blocks.say_zh: 今天学机场入境和海关检查。

blocks.text: ==Airport== Immigration & Customs
blocks.say: Airport immigration and customs.
blocks.say_zh: 这是美国海关的正式叫法。

blocks.text: 学完能做什么：**一个人把海关过完，一句话不多说，一次过。**
blocks.say_zh: 学完这课，你能一个人把海关过完，一次过。

blocks.text: PART 1 · 场景词汇 · SCENE WORDS
blocks.say_zh: 第一部分，场景词汇。

blocks.text: 先认这 10 个词
blocks.say_zh: 先认识这十个词，后面全靠它们。

blocks.eg: What's the purpose of your visit?
blocks.say: purpose. What's the purpose of your visit?
blocks.say_zh: purpose，目的。海关第一句就问你此行的目的。

blocks.eg: This is my first visit to the US.
blocks.say: visit. This is my first visit to the U.S.
blocks.say_zh: visit，访问。purpose of your visit 就是此行的目的。

blocks.say: tourism. I'm here on tourism.
blocks.say_zh: tourism，旅游。注意介词，是 on tourism。

blocks.say: stay. I'll stay for three weeks.
blocks.say_zh: stay，停留。回答待多久就用它。

blocks.say: passport. Here's my passport.
blocks.say_zh: passport，护照。递的时候说 here you are。

blocks.say: address. Here's my address.
blocks.say_zh: address，地址，重音在前。海关问住哪儿，直接给地址。

blocks.eg: Do you have a return ticket?
blocks.say: return. Do you have a return ticket?
blocks.say_zh: return，回程的。return ticket 回程机票，几乎必问。

blocks.say: declare. Nothing to declare.
blocks.say_zh: declare，申报。Nothing to declare 是最标准的回答。

blocks.say: customs. Please go through customs.
blocks.say_zh: customs，海关。记住它永远带 s。

blocks.say: officer. Good morning, officer.
blocks.say_zh: officer，官员。称呼海关官员，叫 officer 就很礼貌。

blocks.text: 这 10 个词里，**purpose / visit / stay / declare** 是必须能说出口的，剩下 6 个能听懂就够了。
blocks.say_zh: 这十个词里，purpose、visit、stay、declare 四个必须能说出口，其余听懂就行。

blocks.text: PART 2 · 场景口语 · SCENE PHRASES
blocks.say_zh: 第二部分，场景口语。

blocks.text: 五句话走完全程
blocks.say_zh: 海关只会问五个问题，一次背熟。

blocks.tip: 回答只要一个词：**Tourism.**（旅游）或 **Business.**（商务）
blocks.say: What's the purpose of your visit?
blocks.say_zh: 回答越短越好，旅游就说 Tourism，商务就说 Business。

blocks.tip: 回答必须**带具体时间**：Three weeks. / Ten days.
blocks.say: How long are you staying?
blocks.say_zh: 回答一定带具体时间，三周、十天。别说 a long time。

blocks.tip: 给**具体地址**最安全：A hotel in Brooklyn, New York.
blocks.say: Where will you be staying?
blocks.say_zh: 别只说住朋友家，说出城市和具体地址。

blocks.tip: 有就说 **Yes, here it is.** 同时把票递过去。
blocks.say: Do you have a return ticket?
blocks.say_zh: 有的话说 Yes, here it is，同时把票递过去。

blocks.tip: 标准答案：**No, nothing.** 别多解释。
blocks.say: Anything to declare?
blocks.say_zh: 标准答案就是 No, nothing，别多解释。

slides.name: 三、场景短文
slides.image_caption: 入境大厅 · 你把护照递给海关官员

blocks.text: You walk up to the ==customs== desk. An ==officer== in uniform looks up and smiles.
blocks.cn: 你走到海关柜台前，一位穿制服的官员抬起头，朝你笑了一下。
blocks.say: You walk up to the customs desk. An officer in uniform looks up and smiles.

blocks.text: Good morning. May I see your ==passport==?
blocks.cn: 早上好，可以看一下你的护照吗？
blocks.say: Good morning. May I see your passport?

blocks.text: Good morning. Here you are.
blocks.say: Good morning. Here you are.

blocks.text: What's the ==purpose== of your ==visit==?
blocks.say: What's the purpose of your visit?

blocks.text: I'm here on ==tourism==. I'll ==stay== for three weeks.
blocks.cn: 我是来旅游的，待三个星期。
blocks.say: I'm here on tourism. I'll stay for three weeks.

blocks.text: Where will you be staying?
blocks.say: Where will you be staying?

blocks.text: At a hotel in Brooklyn. Here's my ==address==.
blocks.cn: 布鲁克林的一家酒店，这是我的地址。
blocks.say: At a hotel in Brooklyn. Here's my address.

blocks.text: Do you have a ==return== ticket?
blocks.say: Do you have a return ticket?

blocks.text: Yes, I do. It's in my bag.
blocks.say: Yes, I do. It's in my bag.

blocks.text: Anything to ==declare==?
blocks.say: Anything to declare?

blocks.text: No, nothing to declare.
blocks.say: No, nothing to declare.

blocks.text: All right. Please go through ==customs==. Welcome to the United States.
blocks.cn: 好的，请走海关通道。欢迎来到美国。
blocks.say: All right. Please go through customs. Welcome to the United States.

blocks.text: TODAY · 今日口袋卡
blocks.say_zh: 最后，今天的口袋卡。

blocks.text: 记住这 5 组问答就够
blocks.say_zh: 记住这五组问答，今天就算过关。

blocks.text: What's the purpose of your visit?　→　==Tourism.==
blocks.say: What's the purpose of your visit? Tourism.

blocks.text: How long are you staying?　→　==Three weeks.==
blocks.say: How long are you staying? Three weeks.

blocks.text: Where will you be staying?　→　==A hotel in Brooklyn, New York.==
blocks.say: Where will you be staying? A hotel in Brooklyn, New York.

blocks.text: Do you have a return ticket?　→　==Yes, here it is.==
blocks.say: Do you have a return ticket? Yes, here it is.

blocks.text: Anything to declare?　→　==No, nothing.==
blocks.say: Anything to declare? No, nothing.

blocks.text: **今天的动作**：打开手机录音，把上面 5 组问答各说 3 遍，回放听自己的发音。明天先不看答案，遮住右边再说一遍。
blocks.say_zh: 今天的动作：录音，把五组问答各说三遍，回放听自己的发音。
